rcases h_T020 with ⟨hlifts, hscalar, hq, hbasic, hmatrix⟩
rcases hlifts with ⟨hgen, DX, DY, hdiv⟩
have hn : Nontrivial (VK K M) := hbasic.2.2
refine ⟨hn, hgen, ?_⟩
intro fx fy fh hx hy hh
rcases hmatrix fx fy fh hx hy hh DX DY hdiv with
  ⟨β, horigin, hform, hfactorial, hchoose, hunit, haction⟩
refine ⟨hn, ?_⟩
intro W hWx hWy hWh
apply h_T022 β W
apply h_T021 fx fy fh hx hy hh DX DY hdiv β hunit
· intro r hr
  exact ⟨(hfactorial r hr).2.1, (hfactorial r hr).2.2⟩
· exact hWx
· exact hWy
· exact hWh
